reason: The cited evidence shows that γ′ precipitates strengthen Ni-based HEAs (E1, E2) and that Ti increases strength in HEAs via solid-solution effects (E3), but none of the passages demonstrate the proposed heat treatment inducing both precipitation and grain refinement in a Ti- and Ni-rich single-phase HEA, nor do they provide evidence for the combined strengthening mechanisms at elevated temperatures in this specific alloy class.
premises: γ′-like ordered precipitates (e.g., Ni3Ti-type) can form in Ti- and Ni-rich HEAs via heat treatment
These precipitates provide significant strengthening at elevated temperatures (700–1000 °C)
Grain refinement can be achieved through the proposed heat treatment
Grain refinement provides additional strengthening via the Hall–Petch mechanism
The combined effects improve creep resistance and yield strength over the as-processed state
